title: gymnadenia cucullata
intro: Gymnadenia cucullata, commonly known as the summer lady's tresses, is a type of orchid plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. It is a perennial herb that has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Gymnadenia cucullata include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and improving respiratory function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
